clue.text: Knight left once over the fate of a cat

indicators.note: left here means departed, so the knight's letter has gone out of the word once

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight
one's lot is one's fate or destiny

explanation.surface: A horseman abandoned a cat to its fate long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' tells you N (knight) has gone from ONCE, leaving OCE; 'over the' just joins it to LOT.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocelot is a spotted wild feline of the Americas.

clue.text: Forbid slovenly person to be last dressing

parts.note: to forbid is to ban
a dag is informal (chiefly Australian) for a scruffy, untidy person

indicators.note: last points to the final letter of the word be in this clue

explanation.surface: Banning a scruffy person so they finish behind everyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: DAG is Australian and New Zealand slang for an unkempt person. 'last' takes the final letter of 'be', giving E.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandage is a strip of material used as a wound covering in first aid.

clue.text: Derivates used to plug

indicators.note: used in the sense of worn and knocked about, so the letters of derivates are rearranged

explanation.surface: Financial derivatives were employed to promote something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' is the anagram signal: DERIVATES rearranged gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To plug a product is slang for promoting or publicising it.

clue.text: A boiler which causes a brouhaha when it holds fish

definitions.text: which causes a brouhaha when it holds fish

explanation.surface: A water-heater that causes uproar once there is fish inside.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition plays on the idiom 'a pretty kettle of fish', meaning an awkward mess or fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: A kettle is a vessel for heating water, and a 'kettle of fish' is a muddle or commotion.

clue.text: Rule of gun starts and ends at noon

indicators.note: starts tells us to take only the opening letter of the word gun

parts.note: when something ends it is over

explanation.surface: A Western showdown rule: the shooting starts and is over by midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' picks G from 'gun'; 'ends' gives OVER and N is the dictionary abbreviation for noon.
explanation.definitionFit: To govern a country is to rule it.

clue.text: Plot first class return to obtain shrub

parts.note: a garden plot is a piece of ground

indicators.note: return signals that the letters for first class come back in reverse order

parts.note: A1 is first class, written AI in crosswords

explanation.surface: Back to a top-quality plot of land to get a bush.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords 'first class' is A1, written with the letter I for the figure one; 'return' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The gardenia is an evergreen bush with fragrant white flowers.

clue.text: It's essential; to put it back in a glass ampoule

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the word for the glass container

parts.note: a vial is a small glass bottle like an ampoule

indicators.note: back of a word means its final letter, here taken from the word it

explanation.surface: It is vital to return the stuff to its glass phial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it back' is the last letter of 'it', T, which goes 'in' VIAL. 'back' wants to be a reversal, but reversing IT gives the wrong letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vital is indispensable, absolutely necessary.

clue.text: Debauched monk may offend rash Russian leader

annotationWithheld.why: Debauched monk may offend rash Russian leader: RAS + PUTIN needs H dropped from 'rash' but no clue word signals it; 'may offend' gives no letters or operation
annotationWithheld.clue: Debauched monk may offend rash Russian leader

clue.text: First class dealer of ships equipment

definitions.text: First class dealer of ships equipment

parts.words: First class dealer of ships equipment
parts.note: read as the first letter of class followed by a word for a dealer, and also as a trader who supplies vessels

explanation.surface: A top-quality supplier of nautical gear.
explanation.walkthrough: C (first letter of 'class') + HANDLER (dealer) builds it, while the whole clue describes the ship's supplier.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's chandler is a retailer selling provisions and gear for boats.

clue.text: Object for exam

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a test is an exam

explanation.surface: An item used for an examination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Object' looks like a noun but is the verb, to raise an objection.
explanation.definitionFit: To protest is to voice disapproval, to complain.

clue.text: Boy the French spoon with

parts.note: a lad is a boy
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French lad spooning with his girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoon' is a verb here: to serve liquid with a big spoon.
explanation.definitionFit: To ladle soup is to serve it out with a long-handled scoop.

clue.text: Royal turn of fate takes you back to drunk yob

indicators.note: turn of signals the word for royal is turned around

parts.note: regal means royal

indicators.note: takes means the word for fate holds another piece inside

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate

indicators.note: back of a word means its final letter, here the end of you

explanation.surface: A royal reversal of fortune brings you back to a drunken lout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn of' reverses REGAL to LAGER; LOT 'takes' U, the back letter of 'you'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lager lout is a British term for a young man made rowdy by beer.

clue.text: Head off from channel island boat

indicators.note: the head of the island's name is cut off, losing its opening letter

parts.note: Sark is one of the Channel Islands, between England and France

explanation.surface: Setting off from a Channel island by boat.
explanation.walkthrough: SARK is a small island in the English Channel; removing its first letter leaves the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's ark is the vessel of the Flood story.

clue.text: Combined to get the girl

parts.note: taken as written
her refers to a girl

explanation.surface: Combined efforts to win the girl over.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as three words, 'to get her' says to win the girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Things done together are joined or united.

clue.text: I am a pen writing verses

definitions.note: iambics, as a noun, means verse lines; the definition is a noun

parts.note: taken as written
Bic is a well-known brand of ballpoint pen

explanation.surface: A pen describing itself as it writes poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: BIC is the trade name of a cheap ballpoint; 'writing' links it to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Iambic metre uses feet of a short then a long syllable, common in poetry.

clue.text: Every one gets a gun or reptile will appear

parts.note: every one is all
I is the Roman numeral for one
gat is old slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Everyone gets armed or a reptile will show up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Every one' looks like a single idea but splits into two pieces; 'gets' and 'will appear' are link words, and the gun word is old American gangster slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: The alligator is a large crocodilian of America and China.

clue.text: The pompous chewed tarragon

indicators.note: chewed means the letters of tarragon are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: The pompous diner munched on a herb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chewed' rearranges TARRAGON. 'The' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Pompous people are self-important and haughty.

clue.text: This agent should face extremes of prosperity

indicators.note: the face of a word is its front, so only the first letter of should
extremes means the first and last letters of prosperity

explanation.surface: An agent must face the outer limits of wealth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'face' takes S from 'should'; 'extremes of' takes P and Y from 'prosperity'.
explanation.definitionFit: A spy is a secret agent gathering intelligence.

clue.text: Despair a change in the garden

indicators.note: a change means the letters of despair and a are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Gloom gives way to something new in the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' signals an anagram of DESPAIR plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise is the Garden of Eden in the Bible.

clue.text: How a buddy may overlap

parts.note: split the last word as over plus lap: a word for a buddy, turned over, becomes lap

explanation.surface: A friend's way of overlapping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' in 'overlap' acts as a reversal signal: the word for a buddy written backwards gives LAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is a mate or friend, and its letters reversed spell a lap.

clue.text: Scene of battle offence at first

parts.note: a crime is an offence

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word at

explanation.surface: An offence committed at the start of a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first' gives A. The Crimean War of 1853 to 1856 saw battles such as Balaclava.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimean peninsula hosted the Crimean War's battles.

clue.text: Blemish of Monica ends at first regret

indicators.note: the ends of Monica are its first and last letters
at first means the opening letter of regret

explanation.surface: Monica's flaw finally prompts regret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' takes M and A from 'Monica'; 'at first' takes R from 'regret'.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar is to spoil or disfigure, and a mar is a flaw.

clue.text: Satellites with air frame strands

annotationWithheld.why: Satellites with air frame strands: MOONS framing AR needs 'air' (or 'with air') to give AR, which no standard abbreviation supplies

clue.text: Craftsmen training tsarinas

indicators.note: training means the letters of tsarinas are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Skilled workers giving lessons to Russian empresses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'training' rearranges TSARINAS; tsarinas were Russian empresses.
explanation.definitionFit: Artisans are skilled manual workers.

clue.text: Feel discontent concerning ache

parts.note: re means concerning or about
to pine is to ache with longing

explanation.surface: Feeling dissatisfied about a pain.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Latin-derived 'regarding' used in business letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To repine is to fret or complain.

clue.text: Weasels, pigs, dogs, swine, skunks or serpents?

definitions.text: Weasels, pigs, dogs, swine, skunks or serpents?

parts.words: Weasels, pigs, dogs, swine, skunks or serpents?
parts.note: a list of animals that are all insults for treacherous people, ending with a hint at legless reptiles

explanation.surface: A bestiary of insults for low characters.
explanation.definitionFit: Each animal name is a slur for a despicable or treacherous person, as are the legless reptiles.

clue.text: Israeli to generate patience

indicators.note: generate means produce something new from the letters of Israeli and to

explanation.surface: An Israeli seeking to create tolerance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'generate' rearranges ISRAELI plus TO. Patience is the British name for the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitaire is the American name for the one-player card game known in Britain as patience.

clue.text: In other words strange diets upset

indicators.note: strange signals that the letters of diets are made odd, rearranged

explanation.surface: Peculiar diets cause an upset stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' rearranges DIETS; 'upset' is a further link word in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Id est, Latin abbreviated i.e., means that is to say.

clue.text: A memory a smell has

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in computing

explanation.surface: A memory that a smell holds.
explanation.walkthrough: ROM stands for read-only memory.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a scent or fragrance.

clue.text: Its thrown out of a field event

definitions.text: Its thrown out of a field event

parts.words: Its thrown out of a field event
parts.note: describes an object hurled in an athletics event, as if banished from it

explanation.surface: Something is ejected from a sports event.
explanation.definitionFit: The javelin is a spear hurled for distance in athletics.

clue.text: Report of a female leopard

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
the ounce is another name for the snow leopard

explanation.surface: An account of a female big cat.
explanation.walkthrough: OUNCE is the old name for the snow leopard. 'Report' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce is to proclaim or make known.

clue.text: Litigate about rubbish going bust

indicators.note: about means the word for litigate goes around the other piece

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action
tat is cheap rubbish

explanation.surface: Going to court over junk that goes bankrupt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bust' looks like bankrupt but is the sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: A bust is a sculpted head and shoulders, a kind of carved figure.
